snippet.title: Echograve Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Echograve Playtest! We are excited to announce the launch of the Echograve playtest!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4020470/Echograve/?utm_source=youtube

The current version of the game offers 30–45 minutes of intense and at times frightening gameplay.
Dive into the world of underground post-apocalypse and take on the role of a security systems engineer in Shahtogorsk.

We hope you enjoy the game, and if you like it, please consider adding it to your Steam Wishlist!

This is the first publicly available version of the game, and we would be happy to hear your feedback:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe0HyUK2IykMRENQ3CjPqxSVWFbaDjjX5hJLPMvlmgmNFqZXQ/viewform?usp=publish-editor
